title: JSFL: fl.Math object missing (pointDistance, transformPoint etc)
description: The fl object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts lacks a fl.Math property. Flash 8 JSFL exposes fl.Math with utility functions. Fix: add Math property to JsflFl interface and makeFlProxy with at minimum: pointDistance({x,y}, {x,y}) -> number (Euclidean distance), transformPoint(matrix, {x,y}) -> {x,y} (apply a 2D transform matrix to a point), and optionally: matrixToScreen/screenToMatrix if those are common. Keep implementations simple/pure. Type the point as {x: number, y: number}.
